sentences.text:
The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Vishal on 18 December, 2015
 M.Cr.C. No.9330 of 2015
18/12/2015
Shri Mukesh Kumawat, learned Panel Lawyer for the applicant/State.

entities.text: State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Vishal
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard on the question of admission.

This application for grant of leave to appeal under Section 378 (3) of Cr.P.C., 1973 has been filed against the judgment of acquittal dated 13.07.2015 passed in S.T. No. 1329 of 2006 by the Judicial Magistrate Ist Class, Mandsur whereby the learned Trial Court acquitted the non-applicants for an offence punishable under Sections 16 (1) (A) (1) (1) and (2) of The Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and Sections 294, 323, 323/34 and 506-II of IPC.
On due consideration of the material available in the impugned judgment, I am of the considered view that it is a fit case in which permission for grant of leave to appeal can be allowed.

Accordingly, application filed by the applicant under Section 378 (3) of Cr.P.C. is allowed and permission for grant of leave to appeal is granted, meaning thereby, the matter has to be admitted for final hearing.
Appeal filed as a consequence of this order be registered and proceeded as per rules, as admitted.
On payment of requisite process fee, office is directed to issue bailable warrant of Rs.10,000/- each against the non- applicants.

He is also directed to furnish a bail bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- each with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the CJM/Trial Court for their appearance before the Registry/Office of this Court on 16/03/2016 and on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the office in this behalf.
Record of the Trial Court be called for.
With the aforesaid, M.Cr.C. No.9330 of 2015 is allowed and is accordingly, disposed of.

(P.K. Jaiswal) Judge pp/
